## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology) — confirmed by broad Technology large-cap strength (AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND) and sector-level outperformance despite mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND.  
Financials are constructive: PYPL (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary showing pockets of strength: TSLA (1W: +12.52% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY, SHOP (1W: +12.96% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: COST (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND.  
Healthcare soft: LLY (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -13.22%) BELOW TREND.  
Industrials mixed with signs of fatigue: GE (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.47% | 1M: +2.03%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +12.96% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +12.52% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: COST (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.56% | 1M: +1.35%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +2.13%) CORRECTION, SCHW (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples and select cyclicals.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Big 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +12.27% | 1M: +24.27%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +55.47%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: SHOP, TSLA, PLTR all RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) — MAJOR divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is driving the market with large-cap breadth and multiple leaders ABOVE TREND: AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +8.07%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +9.40% | 1M: -7.94%) RECOVERY flags internal rotation. Sector performance: Technology (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +6.99%) — internal leadership concentrated in large-cap software and semis.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials show durable 1M strength with pockets ABOVE TREND: PYPL (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +2.54%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +8.59%) CORRECTION signals short-term pause. Sector performance: Financials (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +8.30%) — supportive for risk-on positioning.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is a net lag with several names BELOW TREND: JNJ (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND, MRK (1W: -5.89% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND while UNH (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier. Sector performance: Healthcare (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -1.33%) — defensive underperformance vs market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Technology and select Financial names given RISK-ON with Growth/Momentum leadership; examples to favor include MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to lagging Healthcare staples and select defensives showing BELOW TREND (ABT (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -13.22%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND). Leadership narrowness and the MAJOR divergence (SHOP/TSLA/PLTR RECOVERY) argue for being selective rather than broad re-risking.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND — headline-driven divergence; ABT (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -13.22%) BELOW TREND; COST (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +6.99%) — concentration risk but momentum intact; Financials (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +8.30%) — cyclical support.  
BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -1.33%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -3.71%) — watch for continued defensive underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
ORCL: sustain weekly gains for ABOVE TREND continuation — failure to hold recent breakout would signal mean-reversion risk.  
AMD: hold 1M trend support (ABOVE TREND) to keep momentum thesis intact.  
LLY: reclaim near-term losses (1W bounce) to validate the bullish study headline; continued decline would deepen BELOW TREND risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): study headline bullish but price action shows weakness — LLY (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND — sentiment/price divergence.  
ORCL (+50): Oracle multicloud tie-up has confirming flow — ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
CAT (+50): upbeat note and target lift but short-term pullback — CAT (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +10.07%) CORRECTION — positive catalyst, watch for resumed upside.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABT (-55): negative guidance reaction aligns with price deterioration — ABT (1W: -6.47% | 1M: -13.22%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.  
(Other high-impact negative headlines such as CVS (-80) and QCOM (-55) flagged in news flows; cross-reference with live price data before acting as these names show headline-driven risk.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Growth/Momentum style.  
Technology leaders MSFT (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +17.59% | 1M: +41.75%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +29.36% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk: leadership is narrow and MAJOR divergence (SHOP, TSLA, PLTR RECOVERY) plus headline-driven mismatches (LLY bullish news but BELOW TREND) warrant tactical selectivity.
